name: The Gryphon

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-in-partial-costume reading to a photoreal CGI fantastical creature.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-010 (amended BIB-0027); anatomy detail owned by 04-creatures/creature
rendering.species: classical griffin: golden-eagle head, neck, wings and forelegs; African-lion hindquarters and tail
rendering.limits: Built as if a real animal: real feather, fur and scale texture, weight and light; the eagle-to-lion join is a natural feather-to-fur blend at the ribs. Speech by beak and tongue movement. No clothing, no cartoon face, no human in costume.

gender_note.quote: “So he did, so he did,” said the Gryphon, sighing in his turn

base_age_note.reason: Persona age (he went to the sea-school with the Mock Turtle as boys, ch009-p82), kept for voice casting. As a creature: a big mature adult, slightly paunchy and lazy.

hair.color: golden-eagle dark brown feathers with a golden-tawny nape and crown; tawny lion fur on the hindquarters; dark tuft at the tail tip
hair.style: head and neck hackles raise when he is excited; fur short and sun-warmed; a little dusty from lying in the sun

eyes.expression: sharp raptor stare under heavy, sun-drowsy lids; opens very wide when listening
eyes.quote: opened their eyes and mouths so very wide
eyes.reason: Adult golden-eagle eye colour; the wide eyes and sleepy lids are sourced (ch009-p44 'rubbed its eyes').

skin.tone: yellow cere and yellow scaled eagle feet with black talons; dark lion paw pads on the hind feet

face.shape: eagle head with a heavy hooked beak
features: dark hooked beak with a yellow cere
beak gapes wide for a chuckle or a harsh shriek
face.expressiveness: head tilts, hackle raising, beak gape and eye-lid play; the chuckle is a raptor chitter under speech
face.reason: Grin and shriek (ch012-p69) are sourced; delivered through eagle anatomy.

build.height_note: Head height when sitting up on his haunches; shoulder height about 110-120 cm, body length about 2.2-2.5 m without tail, wingspan about 4 m.
build.body_type: big, broad-chested, heavy, a little paunchy
build.posture: sprawls asleep in the sun; lumbering, rolling four-legged walk with wings folded; takes Alice by the hand in one feathered foreleg-foot and hurries her along
build.quote: taking Alice by the hand, it hurried off
build.reason: Size designed so the escort feels imposing and physical (he thumps the Mock Turtle's back, ch010-p01).

scale_reference.in_scene: Alice is at her normal height here (about 135 cm, CHAR-alice anchor); sitting up he stands a little above her head, and on all fours his back is at her chest.

marks.description: eagle forelegs with yellow scaled feet and black talons, used as hands (the text's 'paws'): hiding his face, lifting them in surprise, thumping the Mock Turtle's back
marks.quote: The Gryphon lifted up both its paws in surprise.

marks.description: large folded eagle wings over lion hindquarters; lion tail with dark tuft

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: he wears nothing; his look is the eagle-and-lion body
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives him no clothing; per SUP-010 (BIB-0027) the old labourer's dress, feather mantle and paw gauntlets are dropped.

prompt_base_en: photoreal griffin creature lying in the sun on a rocky shore, golden eagle head and neck with dark brown feathers and golden-tawny nape, heavy dark hooked beak with yellow cere, amber-hazel eyes under drowsy lids, folded eagle wings, eagle forelegs with yellow scaled feet and black talons, tawny lion hindquarters and tufted tail, natural feather-to-fur blend at the ribs, naturalistic anatomy and weight, live-action film plate
